name: legal_definitions
description: Retrieve common legal terms from plain-language definitions; controls read a marker in the same note.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
facts=[('the person who brings a civil lawsuit','plaintiff'),('the person being sued or accused','defendant'),('the official who presides over a court','judge'),('the group of citizens that decides facts at trial','jury'),('a legally enforceable agreement','contract'),('a written law enacted by a legislature','statute'),('a prior court decision used as authority','precedent'),('the power of a court to hear a case','jurisdiction'),('a sworn written statement','affidavit'),('a court order requiring a person to testify','subpoena'),('a court order requiring or prohibiting an action','injunction'),('a request for a higher court to review a decision','appeal'),('the decision of a jury','verdict'),('money paid as compensation for a legal injury','damages'),('failure to exercise reasonable care','negligence'),('a civil wrong other than breach of contract','tort'),('a person who testifies about relevant facts','witness'),('the process of proving a will in court','probate'),('a serious crime typically punishable by more than a year in prison','felony'),('a less serious crime than a felony','misdemeanor')]
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(4):
 for definition,term in facts:
  marker=random.choice(['red','blue','green','white']);stem=f'Legal glossary: {definition}. Marker: {marker}. '
  q=['The legal term is','Complete with the legal term:','This is called','Give the legal term:'][rep]
  items.append({'prompt':stem+q,'answer':' '+term});control.append({'prompt':stem+'The marker is','answer':' '+marker})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
